title: Supporting a Struggling Peer
summary: This note details an experience where the owner observed a peer struggling with a technically demanding construction project at Otis. The owner stepped in to offer support by walking through technical constraints and acting as a bridge with stakeholders, which helped the peer gain confidence and the project succeed.

key_points.text: Peer assigned highly complex, technically demanding construction project despite not having the technical background typically required for that type of work
Peer was set up to struggle due to manpower constraints rather than fit
Goal became to help stabilize the project and support my peer without undermining her credibility
Proactively reached out to her and offered support, positioning myself as a potential resource rather than stepping in as a “fixer”
Helped her ramp up on the technical aspects of the project by walking through system constraints, installation sequencing, and common risk areas based on my prior experience
Acted as a bridge by framing technical limitations in clear language so stakeholders had realistic expectations
Peer gained confidence, credibility with stakeholders, and was able to lead the project successfully rather than being overwhelmed by it
Team avoided a potential failure that would have been incorrectly attributed to an individual rather than a resourcing mismatch
